rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA grade; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Slight overreach in asserting absence of degeneration/collapse not clearly verifiable from one image.

Integrates age, BMI, prior miscarriage, ovarian response, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, and lifestyle factors well, and explains how these modify prognosis despite strong embryo morphology.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality, age, and BMI. Minor looseness in shifting between 45–60%, 50–55%, and 40–50% real-world odds, but still clinically coherent.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including caution about overinterpreting morphology and not rushing to PGT-A after a single miscarriage. Slightly speculative on some adjunct evaluations/add-ons.

Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization, single embryo transfer, preconception measures, and future-cycle planning. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
